media_file._content: Template Accessibility statement - EN <Use the option Show /Hide (using the button with the symbol [image: Paragraph Show / Hide button in Word] in the menu) to show or hide the instructions in blue> Use this document as a basis for the creation of a page of the type ‘Accessibility statement’, What you need to know when using the template · No colour = content page · ·No colour = page content. What appears in the declaration. · ·Blue = hidden text instructions. Does not appear in the declaration. · Yellow = [give extra attention/make a choice/complete] What should you do before drawing up the accessibility statement? · Check with your customer what contact data you need to collect in order to complete the last paragraphs (on the aspect of ‘what if web users have questions?’) · Check the nature of the audit performed and bear in mind: · Websites and online services can be subject to an internal (using the automatic accessibility checking tool) or an external audit · Mobile applications are always subject to an in-depth audit by a third party (externally) · Check upfront what parts of your website, mobile app or online service are not accessible. Accessibility statement Instruction: give the correct name of the website/app/online service below and fill out the url of the website in the second paragraph, or make a reference to the App store and Google store for apps and delete what is obsolete. <The> <name (+ abbreviation) of the institution of the website/app/online service in bold type> is doing their utmost to make the information available on this Choose an item. accessible to all, in accordance with the Act of 19 July 2018 on the accessibility of websites and mobile applications of public administrations. Consult the full text of the Act of 19 July 2018 on the website of the Moniteur Belge (in French). This accessibility statement applies to the Choose an item.: <name of the website or online service written as an URL> OR <<version no. <xxxxx> of <name of the app>, available in the Google store <link to the app in Google store> and the App store <link to the app in App store>>. Compliance status Instruction: there are different options: · Option ‘Simplified audit’: this kind of audit almost always happens internally, and can never be fully compliant. It results in either a partial or non compliant website (the latter is the case when more than 50% of the criteria produce error messages) · Option ‘In-depth audit’: always done by a third party (e.g. Anysurfer). Don't forget to add the report on the in-depth audit. The website can be found to be: · Fully compliant with the standard · Partially compliant with the standard (up to 50% of criteria show error messages) · Non compliant (more than 50% of criteria show error messages) · In short: · A website and online services can be subjected to a simplified or an in-depth audit, internally or externally · For mobile apps in the App Store or Google Play Store, an in-depth audit by a third party (externally) is compulsory Based on Choose an item. audit, we can conclude that the Choose an item. Choose an item. in terms of accessibility. Please consult the pdf with the full text of EN 301 549 standard on the ETSI website. Instruction: is this website fully compliant and has thus been audited by a third party? Then delete the following sentence. Full compliance can only be guaranteed after performing an in-depth audit. Instruction: make sure to put a link on the words ‘report on the simplified/in-depth audit’ and direct this internal link to the correct page on the same website (H1/Meta title of the report must be “Report on the simplified/in depth audit”). This can be the internal or the external audit report. For more information, please consult the report on the Choose an item. audit. Don't forget to include the link to the simplified or in-depth report. [bookmark: _Hlk171066675]Don't forget to include the link to the report. Non-accessible content Instructions: This paragraph must always be included. Be aware! Have you carried out a 'Simplified audit' for this website or online service? This automatically means that the website or online service is not or only partially compliant. There are two cases depending on whether the report on the simplified audit shows no errors or, on the contrary, gives a list of errors. In the following, keep only the text corresponding to the case in question. Be aware! As this paragraph must always be provided, even in the case of an in-depth audit and a fully compliant result, an appropriate statement is required.
